script_text: Brace yourself, Aries — this week ignites passion, paycheck, and unexpected opportunities, fueling your fiery spirit. Wednesday April 2: Venus squares Pluto in your 11th House, warning of power struggles over shared investments. Thursday April 3: Mercury enters your 1st House, conjunct the Sun, boosting confidence to launch personal projects. Friday-Sunday: Venus trine Pluto in your 10th House turns career ambition into magnetic attraction. Weekend Moon in Leo boosts fun, creativity, and social connections.
